blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Manila recorded 23 new dengue cases on Monday, bringing the total number of cases reported in the city from Jan. 1 to Oct. 12 to 3,822, according to the Manila Health Department (MHD). The department’s latest W.I.L.D. (water- and food-borne diseases, influenza, leptospirosis, and dengue) diseases report also listed 19 new cases of influenza-like illness (ILI) and four cases of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI). No new cases of cholera, typhoid fever, confirmed COVID-19, or leptospirosis were reported on Oct. 12.
